summary: Seanergy Maritime Holdings Corp., a Greek-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K furnishing its letter to shareholders, notice, proxy statement and proxy card for the 2026 Annual Meeting scheduled November 4, 2026 at its Glyfada offices. Shareholders will vote on re-electing Christina Anagnostara as Class B Director and ratifying Deloitte as independent auditors for fiscal 2026. No special-situation transaction is disclosed; the filing is a routine annual meeting notice and proxy solicitation, incorporating the exhibit by reference into existing Form F-3 registration statements.
